purpose: Operational metadata for scripts/ods-test-diff.ts (ODS-ACCEL-02, NODE 1). This registry is NOT an ignore list, a skip list, an allowlist for failures, or authority to accept a failure. It only records previously adjudicated test conditions, together with enough structured identifying evidence (test identity + a comparable failure signature) to let the classifier tell THE SAME CONDITION apart from A DIFFERENT/NEW FAILURE. A condition entry never causes a test to be skipped, and it never converts a failing test into a passing one — scripts/ods-test-diff.ts only reports what it observes.
